# List of international presidential trips made by Donald Trump ## Summary ### Second presidency (2025–present) - **One**: [Canada](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canada), [China](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/China), [Egypt](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Egypt), [France](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/France), [Israel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Israel), [Italy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italy), [Japan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Japan), [Malaysia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malaysia), the [Netherlands](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Netherlands), [Saudi Arabia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saudi_Arabia), [South Korea](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_Korea), [Switzerland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Switzerland), [Turkey](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turkey), the [United Arab Emirates](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Arab_Emirates) and [Vatican City](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vatican_City) - **Two**: [Qatar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Qatar) and the [United Kingdom](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Kingdom) ## Second presidency (2025–present) ### 2025 | | Country | Areas visited | Dates | Details | Image | |-|-|-|-|-|-| | **1** | ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/thumb/0/03/Flag_of_Italy.svg/60px-Flag_of_Italy.svg.png)[Italy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italy) | [Rome](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rome) | April 25–26 | Transited through Italy to [Vatican City](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vatican_City) for the [funeral](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Death_and_funeral_of_Pope_Francis) of [Pope Francis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pope_Francis). Spent the night at Villa Taverna, the residence of the [U.S. ambassador to Italy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ambassadors_of_the_United_States_to_Italy).[[39]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_international_presidential_trips_made_by_Donald_Trump#cite_note-39) | | | ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/b3/Flag_of_Vatican_City_%282023%E2%80%93present%29.svg/40px-Flag_of_Vatican_City_%282023%E2%80%93present%29.svg.png)[Vatican City State](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vatican_City) | Vatican City | April 26 | Attended the [funeral](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Death_and_funeral_of_Pope_Francis) of [Pope Francis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pope_Francis) at [St. Peter's Square](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/St._Peter's_Square).[[40]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_international_presidential_trips_made_by_Donald_Trump#cite_note-40) | [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/5/5b/President_Donald_Trump_and_First_Lady_Melania_Trump_attend_the_funeral_Mass_for_Pope_Francis_%2854485640591%29.jpg/500px-President_Donald_Trump_and_First_Lady_Melania_Trump_attend_the_funeral_Mass_for_Pope_Francis_%2854485640591%29.jpg)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:President_Donald_Trump_and_First_Lady_Melania_Trump_attend_the_funeral_Mass_for_Pope_Francis_(54485640591).jpg) | | **2** | ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/0d/Flag_of_Saudi_Arabia.svg/60px-Flag_of_Saudi_Arabia.svg.png)[Saudi Arabia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saudi_Arabia) | [Riyadh](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Riyadh) | May 13–14 | Main article: [May 2025 visit by Donald Trump to the Middle East](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/May_2025_visit_by_Donald_Trump_to_the_Middle_East)
Met with Crown Prince [Mohammed bin Salman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mohammed_bin_Salman) and [King Salman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Salman_of_Saudi_Arabia). Visited [The Royal Court Palace](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Royal_Court_of_Saudi_Arabia) and [At-Turaif World Heritage Site](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/At-Turaif_District) for Saudi State dinner. Participated in a Saudi-U.S. Investment Forum at the King Abdulaziz Conference Center. Attended the [GCC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gulf_Cooperation_Council) Summit. Also met with Syrian president [Ahmed al-Sharaa](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ahmed_al-Sharaa), becoming the first sitting U.S. president to meet with a Syrian head of state since 2000.[[41]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_international_presidential_trips_made_by_Donald_Trump#cite_note-41)[[42]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_international_presidential_trips_made_by_Donald_Trump#cite_note-ME20252-42)[[43]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_international_presidential_trips_made_by_Donald_Trump#cite_note-43)[[44]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_international_presidential_trips_made_by_Donald_Trump#cite_note-44)[[45]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_international_presidential_trips_made_by_Donald_Trump#cite_note-45) | [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/a/a0/Donald_Trump_state_visit_to_Saudi_Arabia%2C_2025-05-13_P20250513DT-0667.jpg/500px-Donald_Trump_state_visit_to_Saudi_Arabia%2C_2025-05-13_P20250513DT-0667.jpg)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Donald_Trump_state_visit_to_Saudi_Arabia,_2025-05-13_P20250513DT-0667.jpg) | | ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/65/Flag_of_Qatar.svg/60px-Flag_of_Qatar.svg.png)[Qatar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Qatar) | [Doha](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doha) | May 14–15 | Met with Emir [Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tamim_bin_Hamad_Al_Thani) at the [Amiri Diwan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amiri_Diwan_of_the_State_of_Qatar). Visited Lusail Palace for Qatari State dinner. Delivered remarks with troops at [Al Udeid Air Base](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Al_Udeid_Air_Base).[[42]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_international_presidential_trips_made_by_Donald_Trump#cite_note-ME20252-42) | [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/7/74/Donald_Trump_state_visit_to_Qatar%2C_2025-05-14_P20250514DT-1039.jpg/500px-Donald_Trump_state_visit_to_Qatar%2C_2025-05-14_P20250514DT-1039.jpg)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Donald_Trump_state_visit_to_Qatar,_2025-05-14_P20250514DT-1039.jpg) | | ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/c/cb/Flag_of_the_United_Arab_Emirates.svg/60px-Flag_of_the_United_Arab_Emirates.svg.png)[United Arab Emirates](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Arab_Emirates) | [Abu Dhabi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abu_Dhabi) | May 15–16 | Visited the [Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sheikh_Zayed_Grand_Mosque). Met with President [Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mohamed_bin_Zayed_Al_Nahyan) at [Qasr Al Watan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Qasr_Al_Watan).[[42]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_international_presidential_trips_made_by_Donald_Trump#cite_note-ME20252-42) Also visited the [Abrahamic Family House](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abrahamic_Family_House).[[46]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_international_presidential_trips_made_by_Donald_Trump#cite_note-46) Trump made a refueling stop at [RAF Mildenhall](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RAF_Mildenhall) in the [United Kingdom](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Kingdom) enroute back to the United States.[[47]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_international_presidential_trips_made_by_Donald_Trump#cite_note-MildenhallMay2025-47) | [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/4d/Donald_Trump_state_visit_to_the_United_Arab_Emirates%2C_2025-05-15_P20250515DT-1614.jpg/500px-Donald_Trump_state_visit_to_the_United_Arab_Emirates%2C_2025-05-15_P20250515DT-1614.jpg)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Donald_Trump_state_visit_to_the_United_Arab_Emirates,_2025-05-15_P20250515DT-1614.jpg) | | **3** | ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d9/Flag_of_Canada_%28Pantone%29.svg/60px-Flag_of_Canada_%28Pantone%29.svg.png)[Canada](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canada) | [Kananaskis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kananaskis_Improvement_District) | June 15–16 | Attended the [51st G7 summit](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/51st_G7_summit). Held bilateral meetings with Prime Minister [Mark Carney](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mark_Carney), German chancellor [Friedrich Merz](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Friedrich_Merz) and British prime minister [Keir Starmer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Keir_Starmer). Met with [King](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monarchy_of_the_Netherlands) [Willem-Alexander](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Willem-Alexander_of_the_Netherlands) and Queen [Máxima](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Queen_M%C3%A1xima_of_the_Netherlands) at [Huis ten Bosch](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Huis_ten_Bosch). Held bilateral meetings with Prime Minister [Dick Schoof](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dick_Schoof) and NATO Secretary General [Mark Rutte](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mark_Rutte). | [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/f2/OTAN_Summit_2025_I_June_25%2C_2025_%2854611893207%29.jpg/500px-OTAN_Summit_2025_I_June_25%2C_2025_%2854611893207%29.jpg)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:OTAN_Summit_2025_I_June_25,_2025_(54611893207).jpg) | | **5** | ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/a/a5/Flag_of_the_United_Kingdom_%281-2%29.svg/60px-Flag_of_the_United_Kingdom_%281-2%29.svg.png)[United Kingdom](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Kingdom) | [Turnberry](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turnberry,_South_Ayrshire) and [Aberdeenshire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aberdeenshire) | July 25–29 | Made a private trip to [Scotland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scotland) and visited [his golf course in Turnberry](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trump_Turnberry) as well as [his property in Aberdeenshire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trump_International_Golf_Links,_Scotland). He met with European Commission president [Ursula von der Leyen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ursula_von_der_Leyen) and successfully reached a trade deal with the European Union.
